title: Proof of Election: A Formally-Verified Democratic Blockchain Protocol
venue: IEEE International Conference on Decentralized Applications and Infrastructures
abstract: Proof of Election lets stakeholders approve multiple block proposals, avoiding the fragmentation of honest support that can occur with a single-choice vote. A synchronous committee protocol uses certified population support to constrain block selection. The paper formalizes consensus safety, liveness, and a democracy guarantee relative to the candidates seen by the honest committee, with proofs mechanized in Coq. This support guarantee depends on the stated voting, dissemination, and synchrony assumptions.
summary: Lets stakeholders vote on block contents and makes their support constrain consensus, with mechanized proofs of the protocol’s guarantees.
